title:
Abstract type representing a workflow specification that can be converted into an executable workflow.

- Defines validation and workflow creation methods for implementing structured, repeatable workflows.
- Used as a base type for workflow-related specifications in the `ReliabilityOrchestrator` namespace.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.WorkflowConvertable
